summary: Batch C — Notification drawer trust loop (approve/decline inline composer), role gating, dispatcher transient-error retry pytest, and Inventory duplicate SoftWarning — ALL 16 requested checks PASS. Backend pytest suite: 175 passed + 1 skipped (194s, NO failures, NO errors). Frontend role gating, approve/decline flows, inline composer behaviour (cancel + empty reason + one-composer-at-a-time), calm tone (no Reject/Deny/Refuse/Action Required/Urgent), badge count, and Inventory soft duplicate warning all verified.
passing_checks: Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/ — 175 passed + 1 skipped in 194.79s (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported for collection). Includes both test_transient_error_retries_until_cap and test_transient_error_recovers_on_later_success from test_dispatch_retry.py.
Owner role: opened bell drawer → [data-testid='pending-requests-section'] count = 0, no 'Pending requests' eyebrow text. HIDDEN as required.
Groom role: opened bell drawer → [data-testid='pending-requests-section'] count = 0. HIDDEN as required.
Admin role: opened bell drawer → [data-testid='pending-requests-section'] count = 1, with eyebrow 'PENDING REQUESTS' (CSS uppercase of source 'Pending requests') + count badge.

Admin badge: [data-testid='notifications-unread-dot'] showed '9+' (cap reached because 61 pending requests existed in seed). Formula = unread + pending, capped at '9+' visually. Decreases by 1 after each approve/decline (verified row removal + refresh).
Pending-request row data-testid scheme correct: [data-testid='pending-request-<id>'] resolves per row with type label, horse/details, requester_name, formatted created_at, Approve + Decline buttons.
Approve flow: clicked [data-testid='pending-approve-<id>'] → POST /api/service-requests/<id>/approve → toast 'Approved.' (count=1) appears, row removed from drawer post-refresh.

Decline-inline composer: clicked [data-testid='pending-decline-open-<id>'] → no [role='dialog'] modal opened (count 0→0). [data-testid='pending-decline-composer-<id>'] renders with [data-testid='pending-decline-reason-<id>'] textarea + Cancel + Send buttons.
Decline submit with reason: typed 'farrier already booked Thursday', clicked [data-testid='pending-decline-submit-<id>'] → toast 'Declined with a note.' (count=1), row removed.

Decline cancel: opened composer, typed text, clicked [data-testid='pending-decline-cancel-<id>'] → composer collapsed, Approve+Decline buttons restored, request still status='pending' via /api/service-requests (no API call made).

Decline without reason: opened composer, left textarea empty, clicked submit → POST decline persisted (status='declined' with backend default decline_reason='Request declined.'). Toast 'Declined with a note.' appeared. Both calm copies accepted per spec.

Calm-tone audit: button labels 'Approve' + 'Decline' only — NO 'Reject', 'Deny', 'Refuse' substrings in drawer text. Eyebrow 'Pending requests' (not 'Action Required'/'Urgent'). Empty-state copy in code: 'A quiet inbox. We will let you know.'
One composer at a time: opened composer A on request id_a, then opened composer B on request id_b → A composer count=0 (collapsed), B composer count=1. declineFor single-id state confirmed.

Inventory duplicate SoftWarning: seeded grain/'Triple Crown' via API; opened add sheet, set category='grain' + name='triple crown' (lowercase) → [data-testid='inventory-add-duplicate'] visible. Copy: 'A similar inventory item ("Triple Crown") already exists in grain. You can still add this one — or close and edit the existing row instead.' Starts with 'A similar inventory item'. No 'Duplicate'/'Conflict'/'Warning:' substrings. Submit button [data-testid='inventory-add-submit'] disabled=False (never blocks).
Inventory duplicate clears on name change: changed name to 'Strategy GX' (grain) → duplicate warning count=0.
Inventory duplicate respects category: kept name='Triple Crown', changed category='hay' → duplicate warning count=0 (correctly scoped to same category only).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationsBell.jsx: declineFor is a single-id state (not Set) → only ONE composer can be open at a time. Spec-compliant and verified.
NotificationsBell.jsx: 30s polling via setInterval(refresh, 30_000) — refresh() hits BOTH /api/notifications and /api/service-requests (the latter only when canDecide). Correct.
NotificationsBell.jsx: refresh() called on action success (approve/decline) — row disappears immediately after API resolution. Good UX.
NotificationsBell.jsx: badge formula totalUnread = data.unread + pending.length is correct; visual cap '9+' applied when totalUnread > 9.
NotificationsBell.jsx: outside-click handler also resets declineFor + declineReason — prevents stale composer state across drawer reopens. Good.
Inventory.jsx: renderWarnings uses .trim().toLowerCase() on both sides — case + whitespace tolerant. Category equality is strict (no fuzzy match across hay/grain) — correct per spec.
Inventory.jsx soft warning never disables submit — confirmed via DOM disabled=False after warning rendered. Honours 'never blocks' founder direction.

Backend test_dispatch_retry.py uses asyncio.run + monkey-patching (no pytest-asyncio dependency) — clean integration with existing sync pytest harness. Both tests passing as part of full suite of 175.

Minor (non-blocking): /api/service-requests returns 187 entries to the owner role (filtered to their own requests) — payload size is fine for now but consider server-side status='pending' filtering as the dataset grows.

seed_data_creation: Created 6 TEST service requests as horse_owner Charlotte Vance (POST /api/service-requests) on Valentino across types extra_ride, trim_request, blanket_change, hand_walk (x3) — used as fixtures for approve, decline-with-reason, decline-cancel, decline-empty-reason, and one-composer flows. 4 of them were finalised (approved/declined), 1 cancelled-decline left as pending, 2 cleaned up via decline at end. Inventory: 1 TEST 'Triple Crown' grain item created via API for duplicate detection, then deleted post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Token key in localStorage is 'equine_token' (NOT 'equinesync.token' as some docs suggest). Pytest collection requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (3 test files read it at module top-level): export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://barn-ops-preview.preview.emergentagent.com before running pytest. To seed pending service-requests for admin-side drawer tests, login as owner@equinesync.com, fetch /api/horses, then POST /api/service-requests with {horse_id, type, details}. The drawer panel scrolls (max-h-[480px]) when many pending requests exist — use page.locator('[data-testid="notifications-panel"]').evaluate('el => { el.scrollTop += 400; }') to find newly-created rows that fall below the fold. Empty-reason decline persists with backend default decline_reason='Request declined.' (not null), and frontend toast still says 'Declined with a note.' — both accepted per spec.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. All 16 functional checks + full 175-test backend pytest suite pass. Implementation honours founder tone direction (quiet operational awareness, no transactional rejection language), role gating (DECIDER_ROLES = admin/barn_manager/trainer), inline composer (no modal), reversible cancel, optional reason, single-composer state, and SoftWarning primitive reuse for Inventory.
